meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 让 Claude 按步骤把 Telegram 频道接入项目:复制并注册 Telegram 适配器,安装依赖,构建并跑注册测试,再引导创建机器人、存 token、重启,并用 4 位配对码绑定聊天窗口。
howto.when: 没有写死触发词;典型是在用户要求“接入/添加 Telegram 频道”,或 /setup 流程中需要绑定 Telegram 时接管。

say.text: 帮我加上 Telegram 频道集成。
say.note: 开始复制适配器、注册通道并安装依赖。

say.text: 这是 BotFather 给的 token,接下来怎么做?
say.note: 保存 token、用 getMe 验证并重启服务。

say.text: 我想把这个群聊绑定为 Telegram 通道。
say.note: 发起 4 位配对码,完成该群绑定。

howto.what_en: Agent adds Telegram support: copies/registers adapter, helpers and tests, installs the package, builds, runs the registration test, saves the BotFather token, and runs 4-digit pairing.
howto.when_en: No hard-coded trigger; typically used when the user asks to add/enable Telegram integration, or during /setup when Telegram wiring is needed.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and installs the dependency.

say_en.text: Here is the BotFather token — what's next?
say_en.note: Stores it, verifies via getMe, and restarts.

say_en.text: I want to bind this group chat as the Telegram channel.
say_en.note: Runs the 4-digit pairing handshake for it.
